_doc: Example artifact contracts for job-watchdog, a subset of the checks I run. Each check asserts an ARTIFACT (fresh file, log line, note field, state field), never an exit code. Copy to ~/.config/job-watchdog/checks.json and edit. Paths expand ~ and ${VAR} from 'vars'.

checks.name: Brain steward weekly repair pass
checks.fix: Read ~/.config/brain-steward/launchd.out.log; auth failures need a fresh `claude setup-token` in ~/.config/brain-steward/token.

checks.name: Vault autocommit safety net
checks.fix: Tree has had uncommitted changes longer than 30 min. Read ~/.config/vault-autocommit/last-run.log for 'skipped' lines.

checks.name: Finder organizer weekly cycle
checks.fix: A cycle that reaches 'apply' writes apply_report_<date>.json. Read ~/.config/finder-organizer/state/launchd.out.log ('codex classify FAILED').

checks.name: SELFORGE code committed but not on the phone
checks.fix: Committed app code postdates the last successful QA install. Deploy to the phone.
checks._why: Repair 2026-09-23: backup-user-data.sh writes this log every hour, so a log older than 3h (or missing) means the alarm source stopped and 'no alarm line' proves nothing.
checks.not_checked_pattern: DELIVERY no alarm raised, but .* could NOT be verified
checks._why_heartbeat: Repair 2026-09-23 r2: a fresh log proves backup-user-data.sh runs, not that check_delivery ran. A real verdict must appear within 3h: an ALARM line, "all checks passed", or a positive per-check line ("DELIVERY ok: the phone took <sha>" / "ok by timestamp" = the durable OFFLINE check 1 ran and passed; "ok: phone runs QA build" = check 3). r2 repair: the phone is offline most hours, and in that state check 1 still runs, so counting only "all checks passed" made every offline stretch read as NOT CHECKED. The summary line "could NOT be verified ... not a pass" is NOT a verdict by itself.

checks.name: Obsidian REST/MCP endpoint (keeper)
checks.fix: Port 27123 not answering. If Obsidian is running, the Local REST API plugin is wedged; toggle it. The keeper cannot heal that case.

checks.name: Secretary: intake (Gmail + Outlook + Messages + WhatsApp)
checks.fix: Codex writes memory.md every run, including skips. Check the Codex app is running.

checks.name: Canvas course intake (state committed)
checks.fix: State is committed only after brain + Calendar work succeeds. The run is starting but stopping on a blocker; read the newest section of ${CODEX}/canvas-course-intelligence-intake/memory.md.

checks.name: Headless token: brain-steward
checks.fix: Run `claude setup-token` in Terminal and save the value to this file (chmod 600). Documented lifetime: one year.
checks._why: Repair 2026-09-24 r3b: the created date is the file's birth time (stat -f %B), not a literal; the best status is 'lifetime-ok (not validated)' because nothing tests the token.

discovery_not_covered._doc: Scheduler surfaces that exist on this machine but that job-watchdog does NOT scan. An empty 'unwatched' list means 'nothing unwatched on the scanned surfaces', not full coverage.
discovery_not_covered.claude-code-session-cron: Claude Code CronCreate / /loop schedules live only inside a running session and die with it; nothing durable to read.
discovery_not_covered.codex-app-internal: Codex schedules are read from ~/.codex/automations/*/automation.toml only; anything the Codex app schedules elsewhere is not seen.
discovery_not_covered.antigravity-other: Only ~/.gemini/config/sidecars/*/sidecar.json with builtin 'schedule' is scanned; Antigravity agent-manager or workflow schedules stored elsewhere are not seen.
discovery_not_covered.login-items: Login Items / Background Items (SMAppService) are not scheduled jobs and are not scanned.
discovery_not_covered.iphone: iOS Shortcuts automations and on-phone schedules run on the device, not this Mac.
discovery_not_covered.cloud: Cloud-side schedules (claude.ai scheduled tasks in the cloud, GitHub Actions, Google Apps Script triggers) are not visible from local files.
